messages:
sam.w: hey! new hire here, trying to accept the GitHub org invite and getting 'Invitation sent to sam@redwood.com is linked to another account' error. anyone know the fast fix?
sarah.k: welcome Sam! you probably clicked the invite while signed into a personal GH account that also uses the work email. did you try incognito?
sam.w: tried incognito and cleared cookies but the accept flow still offers only username/password, no 'Sign in with SSO'.
leo: two quick routes: 1) remove the redwood email from your personal account (Settings > Emails) then accept; 2) ask an org admin to resend the invite to a different alias. which works better for you?
sam.w: i'd prefer not to touch my personal account emails. can admins resend to my sam+1@redwood.com alias?
sarah.k: i can resend to sam+1@redwood.com. can you check that alias is reachable first?
sam.w: yep sam+1 is forwarding to my inbox. please resend.
onboarding-bot: FYI the onboarding checklist includes a step for GitHub alias invites: https://redwood.dev/onboarding/github-checklist :bookmark_tabs:
devops-bot: @sarah.k resend sent to sam+1@redwood.com. the link expires in 7 days.
sam.w: clicked the new link, got the SSO option, accepted and joined the org! thanks y'all. i don't see any team membership yet though.
sarah.k: adding you to infra/team-devs (write) and engineers (read) now. give it a minute. also enable 2FA before accessing CI.
leo: if you need SSH access for builds, add an ed25519 key: `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "sam@redwood.com"` then paste the pub key at github.com/settings/ssh/new.
sam.w: added 2FA and SSH key, can clone redwood/serving-runtime. all good — appreciate the quick help :tada:
